{{Quote|For Tarnis.|Darth Angral|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Desolator crisis]], a proxy conflict of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' was fought on the Sith warship [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. By the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], as the final stage of his revenge against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic for the [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|death]] of his son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]. Learning that Angral was attempting to destroy Tython with the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the Knight boarded Angral's flagship with the Jedi's apprentice [[Kira Carsen]] in an attempt to disable the weapon and defeat Angral, while their [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] companion [[T7-O1]] disabled the ship's defenses.

The confrontation resulted in the destruction of the ''Oppressor'', Kira Carsen's freedom from the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Children of the Emperor|influence]], and the death of Darth Angral. Despite his failure, Angral's actions were viewed by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] as the spark to ignite the next [[Galactic War|war]] between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
